entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be connected to the right department.
Returns.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number, please?
Sure, it's VF-789-0123.
Thank you. I see the order was delivered 15 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's... well, it's not working right. The screen flickers. I think the whole thing is just garbage. I want a refund.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the screen. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Since it sounds like a potential defect, my next step is to get you over to our technical support team. They can troubleshoot with you and, if they verify a fault, they can authorize a replacement immediately.
Oh, no. I really don't have time for all that. I'm not very good with technical things. It's all very confusing. I just want money back, I don't want to fix it or get a new one.

I understand you'd prefer a simple return. However, for any item reported as defective outside the initial return window, our process requires verification from our technical team. They are really patient and can walk you through it very simply over the phone.
I don't know... it seems like a lot of work. Can't you just help me? I didn't understand the policy, the website was confusing. It's just not what I expected.

I want to be fully transparent with you about the policy for this specific item. The VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window for a refund. This is because once the device is activated, it permanently links the hardware to a user's personal account.
Ten days? I didn't see that anywhere. I thought it was longer. That's so short.

I can appreciate why that would be surprising. It is noted on the product page, but I understand it can be missed. Because you're at day 15 and are reporting a defect, the only path forward is to verify that defect with our support team. Without that verification, I'm unable to process a return.
So I'm stuck with this piece of garbage because I was a few days late? This is overwhelming. I just don't have time for a long support call.

We are absolutely committed to ensuring you have a working device, and a support call is the way to achieve that. But to be clear, a refund is not an option at this stage since the 10-day policy has passed and the defect hasn't been verified.
(Sighs) So I can't get my money back at all?
No, I'm afraid not. But we can get you on the line with a technician right now to get you a working VeloBand Pulse. Would you like me to transfer you?
No... I guess not right now. I have to think about it. I'm just confused by all this. Okay, thanks anyway.
You're welcome. Please feel free to call us back when you're ready to connect with our technical team. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
